id./param/scenario/cs/a_140_cs_030.pack|cs_: "Ah, there you are! Allow me to introduce myself: I am Maxime Médaillé!
"This is my humble Medal Academy, a school where miniature ladies bloom into beautiful flowers!
"We encourage our pupils to journey through Erdrea and gather the maximum number of mini medals they can find.
"As they hunt for medals, they immerse themselves in the world's cultures and acquire at least a minimum of savoir faire.
"But every so often, a born medal-hunter comes along. I sense this in you! The most adroit medal detector of my career!
"However, there is one miniature problem. The Academy is for young girls alone. Sadly, I cannot offer you a place...
"But will I allow such maximal potential to remain untapped?
"By the power vested in me, I hereby enrol you as an honorary member of the Academy!
